note: CONFIRMED MULTIPLE CHOICE. The March 2019 paper uses flat numbering Q.1-Q.30 (not the Q.1-Q.6 sub-part pattern of 2017/2018): Section A is questions 1-6 at 1 mark each, all MCQ, and the paper's own Note (4) states "In case of MCQs, (Q. The weak flagging signal was a false alarm about its cause but landed on a real MCQ: our stored stem ends "...the differential equation is \:", where the trailing \: is a flattened rendering of the printed fill-in blank "______.", not a genuine colon.
